title: Projective completion of a finite rank vector bundle
statement:
Let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal E$ a locally free $\mathcal O_S$-module of constant rank $d\geq0$, with vector bundle $\pi:E=\underline{\operatorname{Spec}}_S\operatorname{Sym}(\mathcal E)\to S$ [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section]. The relative Proj
$$\overline E=\underline{\operatorname{Proj}}_S\operatorname{Sym}(\mathcal O_S\oplus\mathcal E)$$
[def-nagata-relative-proj, lem-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-symmetric-algebra] is Noetherian, and its structural morphism $r:\overline E\to S$ is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism]. If $t$ is the degree-one section induced by $1$ in the first summand, there is a canonical open immersion $j:E\xrightarrow{\sim}D_+(t)\hookrightarrow\overline E$ with $rj=\pi$ [def-weil-open-immersion]. On every affine open $V=\operatorname{Spec}R$ trivializing $\mathcal E$, this is the chart $D_+(t)\subset\mathbf P^d_V=\operatorname{Proj}R[t,x_1,\ldots,x_d]$ given on coordinate rings by $x_i\mapsto x_i/t$ [def-nagata-relative-projective-space]. These identifications commute with restriction and changes of linear frame. The morphism $\pi$ is separated and finite type, and $E$ is Noetherian [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Thus $(j,r)$ is a compactification [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. At $d=0$ it is the identity compactification of $S$.

proof.text: Obtain the actual Sym(O plus F) presentation and proper relative Proj from [lem-amb-vector-projective-presentation]. Obtain its frame-independent affine dehomogenizations and scheme restriction equation from [lem-amb-vector-projective-dehomogenization], and its normalized local projective-space comparison from [lem-amb-vector-projective-frame-model]. Proper over the Noetherian base gives locally Noetherian and quasi-compact total space, hence Noetherian (Mathlib).

Use the vector-bundle affine charts [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section] to view each Spec dehomogenization as a local map from E restricted to V into relative Proj. Scalar compatibility gives the equation over S, and both factors are open immersions. Restriction compatibility and the locally directed cover by inverse images of affine base opens glue these maps by Scheme.OpenCover.glueMorphismsOfLocallyDirected. Equality over S reduces global injectivity to injectivity in one affine piece, so IsOpenImmersion.of_openCover_source applies. This uses affine refinements of intersections, never their affineness. Uniqueness is cover.hom_ext.

The source of the glued open immersion is locally Noetherian and has Noetherian topology as an embedded subspace of the completion. Thus it is Noetherian and compact. Mathlib gives quasi-compactness of the immersion, finite type of its composition with the proper map, and separatedness by composition. The image formula follows by expressing the source as the supremum of inverse images of affine base opens and using the opensRange formula for Proj.awayι. Package the factorization directly as a Compactification. Frame changes follow by linearity, map_sum and map_mul in the symmetric algebra.

When d=0, the presentation theorem makes the completion projection an isomorphism. The vector bundle projection is an isomorphism locally by its recorded trivializationMap and the affine space on the empty index set; Mathlib target locality gives the global isomorphism. Their asIso values supply the exact structural isomorphisms, and the factorization implies the required equation for the compactification inclusion.
